scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=packages/protocol && npm run build --workspace=apps/server && npm run build --workspace=apps/web
scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace=packages/protocol && concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace=packages/protocol && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace=packages/protocol && npm run build --workspace=apps/server && npm run test:unit
scripts.coverage: npm run build --workspace=packages/protocol && npm run build --workspace=apps/server && c8 npm run test:unit
scripts.test:unit: npm run test:suites && npm run test --workspace=apps/web && node --experimental-test-module-mocks --test --test-timeout=60000 packages/protocol/tests/*.test.mjs apps/server/tests/*.test.mjs
